mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_history (item_spec_id, change_type, quantity, before_stock, after_stock, related_document_type, related_document_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{itemSpecId}, #{changeType}, #{quantity}, #{beforeStock}, #{afterStock}, #{relatedDocumentType}, #{relatedDocumentId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_history WHERE item_spec_id = #{itemSpecId}
